verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships a built-in `crewai test` CLI command that runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports detailed performance metrics. Its observability docs also claim the ability to evaluate agents. Because it is a CLI command it could plausibly be scripted into CI, but nothing in the evidence documents CI integration or how quality is scored. Missing for 10: documented scoring methodology and criteria, pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for CI gating, explicit CI pipeline integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
